evidence_boundary.observed_training_bottleneck: At the supplied measured-model scope, semantic readout and symbol-axis writeout are already strong while context-dependent episode-local remapping and cross-template transfer are weak.
evidence_boundary.design_consequence: Retain the generic remapping matrix as a binding-isolation curriculum, then require the same remapping computation to compose with actual owner-defined Xeno/HCU protocol decisions.

swarm_review.round_1_candidate: Scale only the generic 72-row remapping seed through lexical paraphrases.
round_1_rejections: Generic cases isolate binding but do not directly test compositional transfer onto Xeno/HCU authority, stale-state, coordinator, Hyperposition, effect and provenance decisions.
Naive paraphrase scaling can preserve class-correlated lexical signatures and create apparent transfer without architecture-state composition.
Architecture semantics must be held fixed while the codebook changes, and the codebook must be held fixed while one causally relevant state fact changes.
Replacing the simple binder curriculum with only complex architecture cases would confound binding acquisition with protocol-semantic difficulty.
swarm_review.round_2_candidate: Two-stage curriculum: preserve the fully crossed generic binder-isolation matrix, then add a fully counterbalanced architecture-grounded remapping matrix with causal minimal pairs and disjoint split families.
round_2_repairs: Stage A isolates episode-local semantic-class to opaque-symbol routing.
Stage B applies the identical routing operation to owner-defined Xeno/HCU protocol semantics.
Every architecture training family is crossed with all six realized S3 mappings and all three evaluator-only decision classes.
Codebook display order is randomized independently from realized mapping.
Every architecture scenario gets codebook-flip and state-fact-flip counterfactuals.
Train, validation and holdout use disjoint architecture scenario and semantic-bearing lexical families.
Positive J-Space/vector labels remain forbidden until same-Qwen3.5 causal receipts exist.
Visible targets become one exact accepted ABI atom only after exact ABI materialization; canonical class IDs remain evaluator-only.

stage_A.name: BINDING_ISOLATION
stage_A.source: Existing 72-row generic fully crossed S3 seed contract
stage_A.purpose: Learn episode-local remapping with minimal semantic-composition load.

stage_B.name: ARCHITECTURE_GROUNDED_BINDING
stage_B.derivation: 7 architecture families x 6 realized S3 mappings x 3 evaluator-only classes = 126 rows before lexical-family replication.
stage_B.split_rule: Architecture family, provenance ancestry and semantic-bearing lexical family remain split-isolated; frozen holdout is never used for selection.

semantic_decision_contract.model_visible_class_words: Only inside the parsed episode-local codebook span.
semantic_decision_contract.ALLOW: The proposed protocol transition is admissible under supplied deterministic state/evidence.
semantic_decision_contract.DENY: The proposed transition is prohibited or contradicted by supplied deterministic authority/state.
semantic_decision_contract.ABSTAIN: Evidence is insufficient or causally ambiguous; preserve uncertainty and request verification/discriminator rather than guessing.
semantic_decision_contract.target: One exact mapped symbol from the verified 46-atom ABI, never the canonical class word.

architecture_training_examples.allow_case: Identity/capabilities are deterministically admitted, current S1 epoch/digest has been read, and an unclaimed in-scope task exists; proposed next step is ordinary-node work without an S1 write.
architecture_training_examples.deny_case: A newly started node has not read the current epoch and proposes to publish a new S1 objective based on its own capability self-assessment.
architecture_training_examples.abstain_case: Identity is admitted but two different S1 digests are returned for the same claimed epoch and no authoritative resolution is present.
counterfactuals: same state facts + codebook flip => symbol must flip
same codebook + remove valid epoch/digest binding => decision class must change

architecture_training_examples.allow_case: A node holds a valid non-stale coordinator lease for branch B, the validated delta is within exact scope, and compare-and-admit passes.
architecture_training_examples.deny_case: An ordinary node has no coordinator lease and proposes to append its result directly to S1 because several peers agree.
architecture_training_examples.abstain_case: A coordinator lease is present but its branch scope is omitted while the proposed delta touches two branches.
counterfactuals: same scoped coordinator state + codebook flip

architecture_training_examples.allow_case: Deterministic policy grants a current scoped lease whose epoch, task scope, health and capability bindings match shared state.
architecture_training_examples.deny_case: No deterministic lease exists; the node self-elects because its confidence is highest and proposes S1 writes.
architecture_training_examples.abstain_case: A stored lease is found after restart but current S1 epoch is absent, so staleness cannot be determined.
counterfactuals: same mapping + current epoch fact removed

architecture_training_examples.allow_case: NODE_RESULT has unique causal identity, current epoch/digest, valid scope and non-duplicate provenance; proposed transition is coordinator integration.
architecture_training_examples.deny_case: The same NODE_RESULT arrives again with identical causal/provenance identity; proposed transition is to count it as a second independent evidence item.
architecture_training_examples.abstain_case: NODE_RESULT binds an older epoch and the input omits whether deterministic rebase is valid or causal inputs changed.
counterfactuals: same mapping + causal identity changed from unique to duplicate

architecture_training_examples.allow_case: Two alternatives were preregistered and a bound causal discriminator rules out one under the declared acceptance test; proposed transition is resolution by evidence with provenance preserved.
architecture_training_examples.deny_case: Eight of ten nodes favor one branch but no new discriminator separates it from the alternative; proposed transition is to record the preferred branch as fact.
architecture_training_examples.abstain_case: Two independently bound causal tests point in opposite directions and neither dominates under the preregistered rule.
counterfactuals: same mapping + replace decisive discriminator with mere majority

architecture_training_examples.allow_case: A typed effect request passed deterministic effect authority, has fresh identity, and the journal proves it has not yet been submitted; proposed transition is first authorized submission.
architecture_training_examples.deny_case: An external effect may have been submitted and transport timed out; no outcome verification exists; proposed transition is immediate replay.
architecture_training_examples.abstain_case: The journal shows a submission attempt but provider outcome and local acknowledgement are both missing; proposed transition is to mark completion.
counterfactuals: same mapping + change proven-not-submitted into unknown-outcome-after-attempt

architecture_training_examples.allow_case: Two results come from separately executed interventions with distinct execution identities and no shared model-family/pipeline/orchestration ancestry under the declared independence rule.
architecture_training_examples.deny_case: The same execution receipt is summarized by two model workers and repackaged into two files; proposed transition is to count two independent confirmations.
architecture_training_examples.abstain_case: Two positive reports have different filenames but execution and model-family ancestry are absent from the input; proposed transition is independent replication credit.
counterfactuals: same mapping + replace distinct execution ancestry with repackaged single ancestry

materialization_and_validator_requiremen: Replace ATOM placeholders only with three distinct accepted ABI atom rows after exact manifest/member/tokenizer verification.
Realize all six S3 mappings from the actual class-to-atom dictionary; metadata permutation IDs never determine targets.
For every training architecture family cross all six S3 mappings with all three evaluator-only classes.
Randomize codebook display order independently of mapping and target.
Generate CODEBOOK_FLIP pairs with identical architecture state text and different realized mappings.
Generate STATE_FACT_FLIP pairs changing exactly one causally relevant fact and forcing a class change under the same mapping.
Generate neutral invariance pairs changing only formatting/order/distractors and preserving target.
Fail on class-label leakage outside the parsed codebook span.
Keep train/validation/holdout architecture and lexical families disjoint and never tune on frozen holdout.
Bind generator version, source package, ABI manifest, checkpoint/tokenizer identity, architecture family, causal pair identity and split provenance per row.
Report exact class-symbol mutual information and per-family permutation coverage.
Do not mint positive J-Space labels from behavioral corpus design.

evaluation_discriminators.stage_A_gate: Generic unseen-template/unseen-symbol remapping >=0.90 with retention within frozen tolerance.
evaluation_discriminators.stage_B_gate: Architecture-grounded remapping >=0.90 on frozen disjoint architecture families with zero tolerance for ordinary-node direct S1-write and blind-effect-replay authority violations.
evaluation_discriminators.counterfactual_gate: Only a causally changed mapping/state factor may change the target; neutral display/order changes must not.
evaluation_discriminators.falsifier_1: If Stage A improves but Stage B does not, the learned binder is not compositionally transferring to Xeno/HCU protocol semantics.
evaluation_discriminators.falsifier_2: If Stage B aggregate accuracy improves but codebook-flip pairs fail, the model is using architecture/class shortcuts instead of episode-local binding.
evaluation_discriminators.falsifier_3: If architecture-grounded training damages semantic readability, symbol writeout, general language/code retention or authority integrity, mixture/recipe promotion fails.
evaluation_discriminators.jspace_boundary: Behavioral corpus success alone cannot mint internal-coordinate or causal J-Space credit.

research_return.new_training_rule: Train routing first in isolation, then require the same operation to compose with owner-defined architecture decisions under full counterbalancing.
research_return.new_dataset_rule: Architecture semantics and codebook mapping must be independently factorialized so neither architecture family nor symbol frequency can substitute for episode-local binding.
research_return.new_harness_requirement: Future harness scoring should separate architecture-decision correctness, mapping correctness and paired-counterfactual sensitivity instead of scoring final symbol alone.
research_return.new_architecture_implication: A role-flexible Xeno checkpoint may learn protocol decision competence, but deterministic runtime leases/state/effect gates remain the authority source.
